rule.name: AnnotationAttributeNotResolved
rule.message: This annotation attribute is used as it is, while other attributes of the same annotation instance in this method go through resolve(...), resolveEmbeddedValue, resolveStringValue, resolvePlaceholders or evaluate(...). A property placeholder or SpEL expression in its value is then taken literally. Resolve it like its siblings: endpoint.setConsumes(resolve(listener.consumes())). An attribute that is meant to be literal (a class name, an id) can stay raw; then read it before the resolved ones or pass it to a method that documents it as literal.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $resolving := '^(resolve|evaluate)', $guards := ('equals', 'equalsIgnoreCase', 'hasText', 'hasLength', 'isEmpty', 'isBlank', 'isNotEmpty', 'isNotBlank', 'notNull', 'notEmpty', 'requireNonNull', 'contains', 'startsWith', 'endsWith', 'debug', 'trace', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'format', 'valueOf'), $member := function($c) { exists($c[self::MethodCall][ArgumentList/@Size = 0] [*[1][self::VariableAccess]] [let $n := string(*[1]/@Name) return exists(ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1] //(FormalParameter | LocalVariableDeclaration)[.//VariableId/@Name = $n]/ClassType [pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.annotation.Annotation')])] [pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String[]')]) } return //MethodCall[$member(.)] [parent::ArgumentList[not(parent::*[self::MethodCall][@MethodName = $guards])]] [not(ancestor::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $resolving)])] [let $var := *[1]/@Name, $name := @MethodName, $siblings := distinct-values( ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1] //MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $resolving)]/ArgumentList//MethodCall [$member(.)][*[1]/@Name = $var]/@MethodName) return count($siblings) >= 2 and not($name = $siblings)]
